diff --git a/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py b/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py
index 5ec8a4c..e8883c2 100644
--- a/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py
+++ b/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py
@@ -20,6 +20,7 @@
 import pytest
 
 from qutebrowser.browser import shared
+from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes
 
 
 @pytest.mark.parametrize('dnt, accept_language, custom_headers, expected', [
@@ -45,3 +46,60 @@ def test_custom_headers(config_stub, dnt, accept_language, custom_headers,
 
     expected_items = sorted(expected.items())
     assert shared.custom_headers(url=None) == expected_items
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('level, source, text, shown', [
+    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'userscript:theme',
+     'Refused to apply inline style', False),
+    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'userscript:theme',
+     'Unexpected script failure', True),
+    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.warning, 'userscript:theme',
+     'Unexpected script failure', False),
+    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'page:theme',
+     'Unexpected script failure', False),
+    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'userscript:other',
+     'Refused to apply inline style', True),
+])
+def test_js_log_to_ui_filters_source_level_and_message(
+        config_stub, message_mock, caplog, level, source, text, shown):
+    """An excluded message stays hidden while other enabled errors appear."""
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.levels = {
+        'userscript:*': ['error'],
+    }
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.excludes = {
+        'userscript:theme': ['Refused to apply *', '*Content Security Policy*'],
+    }
+
+    with caplog.at_level('ERROR', logger='message'):
+        assert shared._js_log_to_ui(level, source, 66, text) is shown
+    if shown:
+        info = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
+        assert info.text == f'JS: [{source}:66] {text}'
+    else:
+        assert message_mock.messages == []
+
+
+def test_javascript_log_message_logs_excluded_message(
+        config_stub, message_mock, caplog):
+    """A message excluded from the UI still follows the logger setting."""
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.levels = {
+        'userscript:*': ['error'],
+    }
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.excludes = {
+        'userscript:*': ['*Content Security Policy*'],
+    }
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log = {'unknown': 'debug',
+                                              'info': 'debug',
+                                              'warning': 'debug',
+                                              'error': 'error'}
+
+    with caplog.at_level('ERROR', logger='js'):
+        shared.javascript_log_message(usertypes.JsLogLevel.error,
+                                      'userscript:_qute_stylesheet', 66,
+                                      'Content Security Policy violation')
+
+    assert message_mock.messages == []
+    assert [(record.name, record.levelname, record.message)
+            for record in caplog.records if record.name == 'js'] == [
+                ('js', 'ERROR',
+                 '[userscript:_qute_stylesheet:66] Content Security Policy violation')]
